kitDescription: Drake is a Fire-element Burst III shotgun Attacker whose whole kit keys off the team's Full Burst. Every time the squad enters Full Burst she gives all four allies a 10-second Hit Rate and ATK boost, and hands every shotgun-wielding ally (herself included) a much larger ATK boost plus a Max Ammunition Capacity increase on top. While she is simply shooting, she throws out automatic bonus hits: a smaller one on the lowest-HP enemies after every 10 shots, and a larger one on the single lowest-HP enemy after every 5 shots. Her own burst is one big nuke on everything in range, and it leaves her with extra magazine capacity and an Attack Damage boost for 10 seconds. Against a single boss all her multi-target lines collapse onto that one target, so in practice she is a self-nuke plus a shotgun-team ATK/ammo aura.

verdictRationale: GO. All nine kit lines are FAITHFUL: every magnitude is kit-literal, every bucket is correct per the SSOT (atkPct inside the DEF paren, attackDamagePct in Damage Up, hitRatePct through acrForHR, ammo caps as damage-relevant weapon state), and the kit's one genuinely tricky feature — the internal trigger split, skill1 on fullBurstEnter versus the burst self-buffs on burstCast — is encoded correctly on both sides and discriminated by the co-B3 helm fixture. The single S6-vs-driver divergence is the pull-vs-pellet hitCount question (S6's 10/5 versus the driver's 100/50). It resolves in the driver's favour and is a RECON_ERROR on S6's part, not a finding: S6 itself declined to assert it and parked it as a ⚑, while the driver is anchored by an independent same-chassis measurement (brid-silent-track, 43 riders = floor(215 pulls/5) exact), by the cited engine counter semantics, and by its own D5/D6 counterfactuals, which would fail loudly if the counter were per-pull. S5's three REDs are event-schema artifacts (durationShots null vs undefined), not kit divergences; the load-bearing assertions in those same tests pass. Two things for the owner to spot-check, neither blocking. First, the unlocalized third S5 RED: if it is the burst FB-exemption read (inFullBurst === false) rather than a durationShots check, then the nuke's FB-exemption is currently unverified by any green assertion — the driver's D7 covers count and magnitude only — so re-run S5 once the event-field reads are normalised. Second, the shipped note carries three pre-treasure stale strings that contradict the shipped blocks: 'hitRatePct 11.85' (shipped 20.09), 'flatDamage 1254' (shipped 3009.6), and 'ALL FIVE kit lines modeled' (there are nine), plus ⚑4's magazine arithmetic round(9×1.7218)=15, which omits skill1's co-live +50.14 and should read ~20 on drake's own rotations. Those are documentation hygiene — the blocks are right, the reconcile banner records each change — but ⚑4 in particular is written as a measurement recipe and would send a probe after the wrong number. Same-model residual to watch: every agent here is Claude, so the shared prior that 'normal attack' means trigger pull and that burst-cast damage is FB-exempt by timing is stability, not proof; both are backed by out-of-band evidence (the brid-silent-track count, the mechanics SSOT §8), which is why this is a GO rather than a converged guess.
